discoveredOn: DS4/100, 2026-08-19, during the TC-018 build (GUI lane)
note: wnd[1], opened by fwzz-entry's create button. Asks Product Type / Short Name (Shrt) / Long Name plus two radio groups (Active|Inactive, With Reference|Without Reference). This case explicitly selects Active + Without Reference rather than trusting an unread default - GuiRadioButton's read_field returns the label text, not a selection state, so 'the field reads Active' does not prove the Active radio is the one selected. Create (F5) opens the class master (fwzz-class-master.json) - it does not commit by itself.

idNumber.label: ID Number
idNumber.note: Left blank for 26B - see fwzz-entry.json's idNumber note.

shortName.label: Shrt
shortName.note: max 15 chars - SAP truncates silently, does not refuse.

continue.note: Continue (Enter). Dismisses an informational popup, e.g. the internal-numbering notice if an id was typed for 26B. Purely navigational.

createConfirm.note: Create (F5). Opens the class master. Does not commit - Save on the master screen is the actual write.
